name: domotz
description: The Domotz plugin for MSPs and IT teams. It connects your AI assistant to Domotz network monitoring, so it can work across your clients' sites with device inventory and status, uptime, alerts and alert rules, network topology, configuration backups and the account's activity log. Ready-made playbooks turn that data into network-operations work. It explains what it finds and makes only the reversible changes you approve.

interface.longDescription:
Domotz is a network monitoring platform for managed service providers (MSPs) and IT teams. It discovers and monitors the devices on every client site, tracks their availability and performance, raises alerts, maps the network, backs up device configurations and gives remote access to the devices it monitors.

This plugin connects ChatGPT to your own Domotz account through the Domotz MCP server. Ask about any client, site or device in plain language, or run one of the ready-made playbooks for recurring network-operations work, such as tuning noisy alerts, checking that a newly installed site is set up correctly or writing a client's monthly health report. Each playbook shows the evidence behind its findings: counts, devices and dates.

Nothing changes in your account until you approve it. Changes are proposed in numbered batches, every change is reversible, and the undo is shown before and after.

Intended users: MSP technicians and network administrators with a Domotz account.

Limitations: it acts only within your Domotz permissions and never deletes rules or devices. Some settings can only be changed in the Domotz app; those are listed as actions for you. It never asks for or handles passwords or other credentials. Large accounts are analysed one client or site at a time. It needs a capable model for the counting the audits require.
